type: deterministic measurement capability audit, not a cipher search
hypothesis: Concentric readings are reversible coordinate permutations; opposite starts can be equivalent on centrosymmetric numerical grids; scalar cell maps commute with these permutations and unigram sums cannot select a reading.
parameter_range: Each 5x5 grid: clockwise outer perimeter from top left then inner perimeter then center; apply 0/90/180/270 rotations and transpose/no transpose; reverse each full traversal for outward. Exactly 16 named coordinate paths, no added paths after results.
representations: integer cell value (LP1/05 GP sums, LP1/16 decimal cells)
scorer: No language candidate acceptance. Audit only exact histogram equality and fixed additive diagnostic sum(index+1)^2; any position-independent unigram score has the same permutation invariance.
controls: Distinct coordinate labels 0..24 must distinguish all 16 paths
Increment bottom-right numerical cell by one to test symmetry-breaking
Inverse placement must restore each cell
success: All paths cover 25 distinct cells; inverse reconstruction, ring lengths 16/8/1, scalar-map commutation and histogram invariance hold; distinct-label control has 16 outputs.
failure: Any failed exact property is a measurement audit failure, not exclusion of an LP cipher hypothesis.

outcomes.inconclusive: No cryptanalytic conclusion from this audit

coverage_limit: Two known explicit 5x5 grids only; no guessed grids, unknown-page geometry, plaintext scoring, deletion, key derivation, or significance testing.
next_step: Only after defining a geometry-grounded layout, order-sensitive measurement, controls conditional on known symmetry, and independent predictions may a geometric cipher experiment be registered.
